status: Owner-directed equipment relocation; preliminary packaging only
architecture: Kubota, pump, brake-compressor provision, generator, diesel tank, hydraulic reservoir and cooler in an insulated tender; driven locomotive wheels and cab retained for the first study.
generator_candidate: PowerTech PTI-30SI, 30 kW; its own Isuzu engine
lining_status: 50 mm planning space for a noncombustible acoustic/thermal lining, protective oil-resistant facing and perforated metal liner. Product, fastening and complete fire/acoustic performance not selected. No absorbent lining on spill floor; exhaust shields separate.
engine_reference: AIE generic GA used by LT25; quoted Rev B configuration remains unconfirmed. Wider 809.244 mm handedness reservation retained.

equipment.name: PowerTech PTI-30SI candidate
equipment.basis: Published whole-genset envelope and 1,138 lb. Core fit only; OEM service/cooling clearances unresolved.

equipment.name: Diesel tank — 150 L working target retained
equipment.basis: Existing 40 kg tank + 126 kg diesel allowance relocated once. Runtime for both engines, usable volume, baffling and ullage unresolved.

equipment.name: Hydraulic reservoir — fill volume unresolved
equipment.basis: Existing 50 kg tank + 78.098 kg residual tank-oil allocation. Inherited 100 L is whole-system budget, not reservoir fill; longer lines need reconciliation.

equipment.name: Hydraulic cooler — independent side airflow provision
equipment.basis: Retained 170 × 1050 × 1000 mm cooler reservation turned sideways; 55 kg allowance. No heat rejection, fan draw or pressure-drop rating selected.

equipment.name: Engine-driven brake compressor — space reservation
equipment.basis: New unselected mechanical compressor/drive. Space marker only; no approved Kubota drive, capacity, lubrication or cooling arrangement.

equipment.name: Coach electrical distribution — dry compartment
equipment.basis: Unselected panel and protected feeder; separated from tank bay by a partition reservation.

limits: Straight static placement only; 5 m tender pin spacing and 5.8 m added consist pitch are study choices, not confirmed minimum length.
No tender axle, frame, brake, coupler, spring, tank or cooler is selected. Running gear is a space marker.
50 mm lining reservation is not a fire rating or a promised noise reduction. Vent areas and baffle losses require thermal/airflow calculation.
Locomotive adhesion, suspension and train braking must be recalculated with final wet masses and tender geometry. No existing LT42 movement result transfers to the new connections.
Long A/B pressure loops and separate motor case-drain return cross the locomotive/tender connection. No drive shaft across the coupling.
Mechanical compressor and generator have separate power duties; relocating the Kubota does not make its 45.6 kW reference available for both full traction and 30 kW generation.
